notes:
What's new in 0.9.267 (beta)
- Race reels: GOAT overlays can now appear in your race reels, with a "Show driver names" switch.
- Race reels: longer reels fill the length you choose, up to 20 minutes, starting at the start and ending at the chequered flag.
- Race reels: GOAT's own panels are hidden while a reel is filming, so they never appear in the video.
- GOAT Dash: clearer labels, a live optimal lap, and the lap clock shows "–" while you are in the pits.
- Track map: turn numbers on the dash map, and the map no longer learns from replays.
- AC setups: a base setup in this track's folder that was named for another track is renamed to this track too.
- SMART: AC setup changes are previewed in clicks, "nah" counts as no, and a yes to an offered change goes through.
- Overlays: overlay sets stay above the taskbar, and Save / Update are shown in full.
- More of GOAT in Spanish.

Also new in 0.9.266 (not released separately)
- Highlights: the library refreshes on its own when a new clip or reel lands, never while you are watching or trimming one.
- Highlights: the "Your video is ready" banner names your newest video, and a deleted video shows as missing instead of 0 MB.
- Highlights: your clip folder is only ever tidied by the installed GOAT app.
- Race reels (AC): with driver names on, only the leaderboard stays on screen.
- Overlay menus: a menu that does not fit a short overlay opens beside it, so every option is in reach.
- SMART: no wrong corner names, talks to you rather than about you, and no setup verdict on a setup you have already changed.
- SMART: once you say no to a setup offer, a later "yes" won't bring it back; "No problem, go ahead" counts as yes.
- SMART: your qualifying debrief is kept when the race starts straight after.
- AC setups: a setup brought from another track is saved under the current track's name.

Also new in 0.9.265 (not released separately)
- Hide overlays / Show overlays button on the telemetry bar (iRacing and Assetto Corsa).
- Reference Lap menu: every pick says what it did; the Lap Timer follows a reference you set mid-session.
- SMART: setup advice by corner speed (aero first for fast corners, mechanical for slow), no false references, and tyre pressures said in plain words.
- SMART: when you must box now it says so first; corners without a name never silence a call.
- Race reels: frozen TV angles are caught before they reach a reel, and the reel never changes your display.
- Tracks without official turn numbers use GOAT's own numbers and verified corner names.
- GOAT Dash Pulse: the predicted lap is labelled "predicted".
- More Spanish: share panel, YouTube upload, reel status lines, tray menu, debrief and corner calls.
